role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 整个战场就是一个舞台，而百戏大王正是欢腾的导演。百戏大王利用表演家的架势操控战斗，手中可怕的长鞭和无尽的飞刀可以驯服敌人，狡猾的逃脱表演能将盟友带离危险 ，而且他总能勉强观众去观看迷人的奇观转轮。
hero_summary_en: All the battlefield's a stage, and Ringmaster is a gleeful director. Controlling fights with a showman's flair, Ringmaster tames enemies with his fearsome whip and endless knives, ushers allies away from danger with his cunning escape act, and always draws a crowd to unwillingly witness the wonders of his mesmerizing wheel.

abilities.name: ringmaster_tame_the_beasts
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 百戏大王卷起他的鞭子，最多持续%abilitychanneltime%秒，然后猛甩出去。被鞭打的敌人会受到伤害，并且被恐惧，逃离百戏大王。持续施法时间会使伤害和恐惧时间成倍增加，但是作用范围减少。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to %abilitychanneltime% second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.

abilities.name: ringmaster_the_box
abilities.description_zh: 把一名友方英雄装进可动的异维度箱子。友军被装入后拥有相位移动状态，获得额外魔法抗性、减速抗性和移动速度。并且无法成为目标，被锁闭、沉默和缴械。效果结束后或者移动到初始区域之外箱子都会打开。
abilities.description_en: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.

scepter_loc.en: Escape Act has %max_charges% charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 逃生技拥有%max_charges%点能量点数。逃生箱打开时会朝所有方向放出尖刀戏匕首，并且范围内所有敌人受到伤害。

abilities.name: ringmaster_impalement
abilities.description_zh: 百戏大王向自己精心选择的地点扔出一把匕首。匕首击中敌人会造成即时伤害，短暂减速击中的单位，并且使他们流血。流血的英雄受到基于目标最大生命值一定百分比的每秒伤害，流血的非英雄单位受到每秒固定伤害。
abilities.description_en: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.

abilities.name: ringmaster_spotlight
abilities.description_zh: 百戏大王用%spotlight_count%束聚光灯照亮一片区域。灯光下的敌人有几率丢失攻击，隐身状态下也会显形。被光束击中的幻象会逐渐消散，每秒失去一定百分比的最大生命值。这些效果在灯束离开后会粘滞%linger_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Ringmaster shines %spotlight_count% spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds after leaving the light.

abilities.name: ringmaster_wheel
abilities.description_zh: 百戏大王推出奇观轮向目标地点滚去，击退沿途的敌人。到达目的地后，范围内的敌人会持续受到伤害，并且被减速%aura_slow%%%。敌方英雄面对转轮超过%face_duration%秒会被迷住，朝其走去。首个敌人着迷后会触发转轮爆炸的倒计时。如果没有触发倒计时，在%trap_duration%秒后转轮会自动爆炸。
abilities.description_en: Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by %aura_slow%%%.Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than %face_duration% seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after %trap_duration% seconds.

abilities.name: ringmaster_dark_carnival_souvenirs
abilities.description_zh: 只要百戏大王附近%souvenir_collection_range%范围内有敌方英雄阵亡，他就会随机获得一件可用一次的暗黑狂欢纪念品。额外的纪念品会以能量的形式存下。如果百戏大王没有纪念品，阵亡时会获得一件。
abilities.description_en: Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within %souvenir_collection_range% units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.
facet_text_en: Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Funhouse Mirror, Strongman Tonic, and Whoopee Cushion.
Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Crystal Ball, Unicycle, and Weighted Pie.
facet_text_zh: 百戏大王的纪念品是哈哈镜，强力水和整蛊垫。
百戏大王的纪念品是水晶球，独轮车和超重派。

abilities.name: ringmaster_funhouse_mirror
abilities.description_zh: 使用：比例失真制造英雄的%images_count%个不完美幻象，持续%illusion_duration%秒。幻象继承%tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%攻击力，承受%tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%%伤害。
abilities.description_en: Use: Proportion DistortionCreates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds. Your illusion deals %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%% and takes  %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.
notes_zh: 有%invuln_duration%秒的施法时间，其间处于无敌状态。
notes_en: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.

abilities.name: ringmaster_strongman_tonic
abilities.description_zh: 使用：强力吸收暂时提升友方英雄的力量，数值为%strength_bonus_base% + %strength_bonus_per_level% * 百戏大王等级，持续%duration%秒。效果会维持%effect_strength_max_duration%秒然后在持续时间内不断减弱。
abilities.description_en: Use: Forcefully ImbibeTemporarily increases an allied hero's Strength by %strength_bonus_base% plus %strength_bonus_per_level% per Ringmaster's level for %duration% seconds. The effect holds for %effect_strength_max_duration% seconds and then deteriorates over the duration.

abilities.name: ringmaster_whoopee_cushion
abilities.description_zh: 使用：噗把英雄向前推动%leap_distance%距离。在身后留下一团%fart_cloud_radius%范围的臭云，持续%fart_cloud_duration%秒，使敌人减速%fart_cloud_slow%%%。
abilities.description_en: Use: WhoopsiePropels your hero forward %leap_distance% units. Leaves a %fart_cloud_radius% radius stink cloud behind for %fart_cloud_duration% seconds that slows enemies by %fart_cloud_slow%%%.

abilities.name: ringmaster_summon_unicycle
abilities.description_zh: 使用：上车召唤一辆快速的独轮车并骑上去，持续%mount_duration%秒。上车%damage_grace_period%秒后受到来自敌方英雄的伤害超过%damage_threshold%点会让他下车。撞到树木会将其摧毁，并且独轮车会减速。攻击、使用持续施法类技能或者撞到单位和其他障碍物都会使他下车。
abilities.description_en: Use: Saddle UpSummons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for %mount_duration% seconds. %damage_grace_period%s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than %damage_threshold% dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_whip_debuff_immunity
talents_raw.name_loc: Debuff Immunity While Channeling Tame the Beasts

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_dagger_bleed_and_slow_duration
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_bleed_duration}s Impalement Arts Bleed and Slow Duration

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_wheel_radius
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_mesmerize_radius} Wheel of Wonder Radius and Range

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_the_box_strong_dispel_and_flying
talents_raw.name_loc: Escape Act Grants Strong Dispel and Flying
